name: CritiquePlus Comparator
author: critiqueplus

sections.description:
CritiquePlus Comparator helps publishers and businesses create, organize and
publish structured comparisons without requiring an external account.

Features include:

  • Product and comparison libraries.
  • Reusable public comparison layouts.
  • Manual comparison criteria, scores, advantages, disadvantages and FAQs.
  • Affiliate-link attributes, transparency notices and optional link checking.
  • CSV, JSON and XML import tools.
  • CSV and JSON exports plus complete backups.
  • Optional local, anonymous views and affiliate-click statistics.
  • Product, Review, ItemList, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList structured data.
  • Compatibility foundations for Rank Math, Yoast SEO and All in One SEO.

The free plugin is fully functional without an account, licence key, paid
subscription or connection to CritiquePlus. CritiquePlus Comparator Pro is a
separate optional add-on. No premium executable code is included in this
WordPress.org package.

The plugin does not install sample products or publish demonstration content
when it is activated.

CritiquePlus Comparator Pro

CritiquePlus Comparator Pro is a separate, optional add-on for publishers who
need more advanced comparison workflows. It requires the free plugin and is
distributed outside WordPress.org.

The Pro add-on provides:

  • Personalized product recommendation calculators.
  • Dedicated side-by-side Versus pages.
  • An integrated AI assistant for supported editorial workflows.
  • Guided setup and publishing workflows.
  • Additional advanced tools for managing comparison projects.

The free edition remains fully functional without a CritiquePlus account,
licence key or paid subscription. No Pro executable code is included in the
WordPress.org package.

Learn more about the optional Pro add-on at
https://app.critiqueplus.com/plugins/critiqueplus-comparator

Privacy

Anonymous statistics and affiliate-click tracking are disabled by default.
When an administrator explicitly enables them, event information is stored
locally in WordPress. The plugin does not store visitor IP addresses, raw user
agents or visitor cookies in its statistics tables.

No analytics information is transmitted to CritiquePlus.

External services

CritiquePlus Comparator does not contact CritiquePlus servers automatically
and does not require a CritiquePlus account. Help and Upgrade links open only
after an administrator chooses them.

The plugin can contact another website in the following administrator-initiated
or administrator-enabled situations:

  • Remote import: the plugin requests a CSV, JSON, XML or API URL entered by an
    administrator. An optional API key is sent only to that configured URL.
  • Affiliate-link verification: the plugin requests a saved destination to read
    its HTTP availability status. The destination can receive the WordPress
    server IP address and link-checker user agent as part of the normal request.
  • Affiliate navigation: a visitor who chooses an affiliate button is sent to
    the destination configured by the site administrator.

No personal visitor information is sent to CritiquePlus by these operations.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Select the CritiquePlus Comparator ZIP file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open Comparator in the WordPress administration menu.
  5. Create products, criteria and a comparison before publishing it.
sections.faq:
Is an account required?

No. The free plugin works without a CritiquePlus account, subscription or
licence key.

Does activation publish sample content?

No. Activation creates only the plugin database structure and permissions.

Is visitor tracking enabled automatically?

No. Anonymous statistics and affiliate-click tracking are disabled by default
and can be enabled by an administrator.

Where are comparison data stored?

Products, criteria, comparisons and optional events are stored in tables owned
by the WordPress installation.

Can I remove plugin data during uninstall?

Yes. Data removal must first be explicitly enabled in the advanced settings.
The default uninstall behaviour preserves content.

Does the plugin include a paid trial?

No. The WordPress.org plugin is the complete free edition. The optional Pro
add-on is installed separately.
sections.changelog:
0.28.61

  • Fixed the blank Publication tab in the comparison editor and hardened its saved-state handling.
  • Replaced the final public table label with an accessible Offers label while preserving every offer button.
  • Exposed the comparison primary image, alternative text, SEO metadata and structured data to search and social integrations.
  • Invalidated public comparison caches after catalogue changes so product features appear immediately.
  • Improved visible success, validation, media-sync and API error messages in comparison and product editors.

0.28.60

  • Connected the main product image and alternative text to public markup, WordPress media, social metadata, and structured data.
  • Improved the accessible gallery close control and corrected the reported Plugin Check findings.
  • Added safe deactivation cleanup for scheduled tasks while preserving user data.

0.28.59

  • Moved the product primary image into the upper-right corner of the detailed presentation panel.
  • Added a final Images du produit gallery with horizontal thumbnails and an accessible modal viewer.
  • Applied the Images du produit title to gallery media and exposed gallery images in Product structured data.
  • Corrected the SEO preview URL and title colors with reliable inline presentation values.

0.28.58

  • Completed the product-editor-to-public-sheet field mapping, including primary images, offers, commercial facts, features, and technical data.
  • Added reliable direct WordPress media upload for product primary images.
  • Rendered advantages with green checks and disadvantages with red crosses.
  • Added Product, Review, and Organization JSON-LD to individual product pages.
  • Rebuilt the product SEO preview and added a Pro-gated AI generation control.

0.28.57

  • Connected catalogue Résumé and Détails disclosures to product short and long descriptions.
  • Made catalogue search, category, feature, and platform filters update results and counts immediately.
  • Completed rating, name, relevance, and recent sorting and broadened indexed product data.
  • Exposed additional product-editor data on public product sheets and preserved affiliate-link attributes.
  • Audited public selectors, interaction targets, and CritiquePlus database prefixes.

0.28.56

  • Removed public resource sidebars and placed their cards below comparison, calculator, and Versus content.
  • Expanded central public content and aligned headings to a consistent 64-pixel desktop margin.
  • Applied the same responsive page margin to every plugin-rendered public page.
  • Moved public catalogue links to the right side of page introductions on desktop.

0.28.55

  • Distributed wide public layouts across the complete viewport independently of theme container limits.
  • Moved central comparison content toward the left edge and resource cards toward the right edge while keeping both visible at 100% zoom.

0.28.54

  • Kept wide comparison and experience layouts inside the viewport while using the empty left margin.
  • Kept resource sidebars fully visible at the right edge without reducing the central content unnecessarily.
  • Improved catalogue filter spacing, filter icon size, and search-field width.
  • Added a server-rendered product-features section below detailed advantages.

0.28.53

  • Fixed the product features editor panel after a bundled JavaScript function-name collision.
  • Anchored wide public layouts on the existing left edge and moved resource sidebars farther right.

0.28.52

  • Added structured product features to the editor, public product sheets, comparison tables, and product schema.
  • Rebuilt the public product catalogue with server-rendered cards, search, filters, and sorting.
  • Expanded public layouts for comparison, calculator, and Versus pages while preserving responsive behavior.
  • Renamed public library wording to catalogue.

0.28.51

  • Expanded standalone comparison, calculator and Versus pages to use the available desktop viewport.
  • Prioritized central comparison content while keeping resource cards compact and responsive.
  • Added semantic comparison summaries, table captions, explicit column structure and richer product criterion schema data.

0.28.50

  • Fixed published product retrieval by reading product details from settings JSON instead of nonexistent SQL columns.
  • Added three similar-product cards below individual public product sheets.
  • Widened public comparison layouts and improved desktop and mobile presentation.
  • Added circular, contain-fit public logos, a highlighted criteria column, left-aligned content and premium card numbering.

0.28.49

  • Added route fallbacks for public product and comparison libraries and detail pages.
  • Added published-only View actions to comparison and product editors and libraries.
  • Expanded public product pages into detailed product sheets using editor data.

0.28.48

  • Restored public comparison styling with valid WordPress stylesheet dependencies and early enqueueing.
  • Added comparison-specific browser titles to preview pages.
  • Unified the Comparator administration menu labels in French.
  • Changed published comparison and product actions from Publish to Update.

0.28.47

  • Removed the obsolete public click endpoint and retained the validated analytics endpoint only.
  • Restricted user administration to site administrators and protected privileged accounts.
  • Prevented analytics requests and browser storage when the relevant tracking option is disabled.
  • Prefixed the weekly cron schedule, expanded explicit uninstall cleanup and documented Tailwind CSS.
  • Routed temporary import and backup files through the WordPress filesystem API.
  • Expanded PHP and JavaScript translation support and updated the product-specific plugin URL.

0.28.46

  • Replaced the historical short global and data prefix with the WordPress-compliant critco prefix.
  • Added a non-destructive migration for existing settings, tables, user metadata and role capabilities.
  • Loaded administration branding through the WordPress stylesheet API.
  • Prepared translations for distribution through translate.wordpress.org.

0.28.45

  • Unified every Pro invitation in the dashboard and Upgrade page with the official CritiquePlus Comparator product page.

0.28.44

  • Prepared a clean WordPress.org release package without development-only files.
  • Kept the human-readable administration source and reproducible build instructions.
  • Confirmed compatibility with the separately installed Pro add-on.

0.28.43

  • Replaced all internal extension and scheduled-event hooks with the complete CritiquePlus Comparator
    prefix required by WordPress coding standards.
  • Moved build documentation to an accepted production text file.

0.28.42

  • Updated the plugin author identity to CritiquePlus and the plugin website to
    app.critiqueplus.com.
  • Documented the separate CritiquePlus design-system reference used for future
    product interfaces.

0.28.41

  • Removed automatic sample catalogue creation from activation.
  • Disabled local anonymous statistics and affiliate-click tracking by default.
  • Rebuilt the administration application with WordPress wp-element instead
    of bundling a separate React and ReactDOM runtime.
  • Added the human-readable administration source and reproducible build steps.
  • Cleaned the WordPress.org package structure and release documentation.

0.28.40

  • Added an extensible preview renderer for optional comparison templates.

0.28.39

  • Replaced demonstration notifications with current catalogue events.
  • Added extension points for optional comparison templates.

0.28.38

  • Added a secure manual FAQ editor and public FAQ schema output.
  • Corrected SQL placeholder warnings reported by Plugin Check.

For the complete development history, see changelog.txt in the plugin package.
